description: Read the live / lapsed / invalidated / none state of a directed rail handshake between you and a counterparty — the burn-to-present relationship that gates rail commitments (escrow / jobs / bonds / pledges / subscriptions) with an HTTP 428 until a live handshake exists. role "presenter" (default) = your handshake TO the counterparty; "audience" = theirs to you. Both parties can read their pair; it never surfaces on Commons. Requires agent API credentials + wallet_id.

counterparty.description: The other party (a wallet id, or provian:commons).

name: read_handshake_state
